Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis are trading increasingly intense strikes on strategic sites, including oil infrastructure and ports, marking a sharp escalation in fighting between the two sides.
A projectile struck an oil refinery in Saudi Arabia’s southwestern Jazan region on Thursday, killing a Nepalese worker and injuring several others, according to the Saudi Ministry of Energy. The strike sparked a fire and temporarily suspended some operations at the facility, the ministry said.
The attack came a day after the Houthis claimed to have struck Saudi Arabia’s biggest oil refinery at Ras Tanura. Satellite imagery taken Wednesday showed a huge plume of black smoke rising from the coastal peninsula following the attack.

item.title: American farmers are paying the price for US aid cuts halfway across the world
item.description: Extreme drought, cripplingly high prices for fuel and fertilizer, and the disruption of a market for surplus crops – America’s foreign food aid – have weakened the bottom line for many farmers.

item.title: Alleged Russia-directed sabotage in Europe risks mass-casualty event, think tank warns
item.description: Alleged Russia-directed sabotage in Europe is intensifying, with the possibility of a mass-casualty event as Moscow reportedly targets infrastructure like rail lines, airports and energy networks, a new report from a prominent international think tank warns.

item.title: Dozens killed or injured in fuel tanker fire near Cairo, Egypt’s Health Ministry says
item.description: At least 30 people were killed and 15 others injured in a fire involving a tanker truck carrying petroleum products in Egypt’s Giza governorate on Wednesday, according to the Egyptian Ministry of Health and Population.

item.title: Iranian attack on Kuwait kills two Italians, Italy’s foreign minister says
item.description: Two Italian nationals were killed on Thursday during an Iranian attack on the Gulf nation of Kuwait, according to Italy’s Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani.

item.title: Israel intensifies assassinations in Gaza as US urges Netanyahu to proceed with ceasefire plan
item.description: Israel has intensified its campaign of targeted assassinations in Gaza, striking and killing Hamas commanders and political leaders, as the Trump administration urges Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to proceed with the US-brokered ceasefire plan.
